step1_analysis.description: A differential pair with PMOS active loads. Given the paper's context, this likely serves as an analog front-end amplifier or a summer stage for the Decision Feedback Equalizer (DFE), where tap currents would be summed at the output nodes.

paper_reference.title: 28Gb/s 560mW Multi-Standard SerDes with SingleStage Analog Front-End and 14-Tap DecisionFeedback Equalizer in 28nm CMOS

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the stage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 560mW is for the entire SerDes. For this single stage in SKY130, a 200uA tail current is chosen to keep the PMOS loads in saturation, resulting in ~360uW.
Assuming diode-connected PMOS loads for self-biasing, the gain is limited to the ratio of transconductances. The paper's 15dB likely refers to a stage with current-source loads or a multi-stage AFE.

bandwidth_3db.description: Frequency at which the gain drops by 3dB from its DC value.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is determined by the PMOS 1/gm resistance and the parasitic capacitances of the transistors.
Self-biased by the diode-connected PMOS loads. Leaves enough headroom for the NMOS pair and tail current source.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring DC power, common-mode voltage, AC gain, 3dB bandwidth, and transient response of the differential amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Differential Amplifier / DFE Summer
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N2 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Supply and Inputs
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5 sin(0.9 0.1 100Meg)
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5 sin(0.9 -0.1 100Meg)

* Tail current source (200uA to keep PMOS in saturation)
I_tail N1 0 200u

* Configure PMOS as diode-connected loads for self-biasing
Vshort1 N4 N2 0
Vshort2 N3 N0 0

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  let vout_cm = (v(N0) + v(N2))/2
  print vout_cm

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1Meg 100Gig
  let vout_diff_ac = v(N0) - v(N2)
  let gain_db = 20*log10(mag(vout_diff_ac))
  meas ac dc_gain MAX gain_db
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='dc_gain - 3' fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 100p 20n
  meas tran vout_p_max max v(N0)
  meas tran vout_p_min min v(N0)
  meas tran vout_n_max max v(N2)
  meas tran vout_n_min min v(N2)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
